subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retain a post-publish GitHub Release repair path for CLI releases, and if so should it remain a standalone workflow or move into a release-only mode in the npm workflow?
rationale: The PR removes a privileged manual recovery path, and source inspection shows the remaining workflow is not currently equivalent after npm publish succeeds; retiring or redesigning that operational path needs release-owner intent.

options.title: Replace Before Deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that works after npm has already accepted the package, then update the runbook and workflow tests.

options.title: Keep The Workflow
options.body: Leave the standalone repair workflow and runbook in place until release owners decide the recovery path is no longer needed.

options.title: Retire With Owner Acceptance
options.body: Accept the loss of standalone repair automation only with explicit release-owner approval and a documented manual recovery procedure.

recommendation.title: Replace Before Deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that works after npm has already accepted the package, then update the runbook and workflow tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick introduced the workflow and runbook and is also proposing its retirement, so he is the best available owner for deciding the intended replacement or retirement path.
